title: Phrasal verbs 1
note: LEXIS pack: the meanings. The grammar (separable/inseparable, pronoun position) is b1_phrasal_verbs, which plays immediately before. Course doc wants ~60 cumulative across packs 1 and 2. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. Four of the eight shipped frames could never gap: three used a past form (*threw away*, *ran out of*, *looked up*) and one SPLIT the verb (*pick me up*), which is exactly what the pack teaches — but sentenceToFrame matches the lemma string literally, so a split frame produces no gap. Every frame here keeps its particle next to its verb; the split belongs to b1_phrasal_verbs, and the frames page now says so. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. F7: *get up* belongs to leaf_get_b1 (path 43) and *clean up* to leaf_environment_b1 (39); replaced with **wash up** and **stay in**. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_phrasal_1_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: six rewrite items — the paraphrase had swallowed the object, so the swap left the phrasal verb with nothing after it. The underline now stops at the verb.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: Many of these split around the object: *turn the light **off***, *pick the children **up***. The grammar of that split is **Phrasal verbs 1** (b1_phrasal_verbs), which plays just before this pack. Here the job is the meaning.
intro.note_cz: Gramatiku dělitelnosti řeší b1_phrasal_verbs, tady jde o význam.
